verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents a public REST API with Basic Auth, JSON responses, API key provisioning, idempotency headers, official SDKs, and a browser API Explorer, and a live probe confirmed an llms.txt API reference. Resources such as usage events and exports are documented as programmatic endpoints. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
